description_en: Searches for the top N images most similar to a specified image or face ID from a media set, and returns the corresponding face IDs and bounding boxes. The results are sorted by similarity in descending order
description_zh: 从媒体集中搜索与指定图片或人脸ID最相似的前N张图片，并返回相应人脸ID及边界框，返回结果按照相似度降序排列
kebab_example: aliyun imm find-similar-faces --project immimagetest --set-id set001 --image-uri oss://imm-test/testcases/face1.jpg --face-id 59edc040d0a8f4952b183d1b5044913a0ccd8739500ee2705ffe4965a0406a51 --limit 5 --min-similarity 0.8 --response-format v2 --api-version 2017-09-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: FindSimilarFaces

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the media set
parameters.name: set_id

parameters.help_en:
The OSS URI of the image.

The OSS URI follows the format `oss://bucket/object`, where bucket is the name of an OSS bucket in the same region as the current project, and object is the file path
parameters.help_zh:
图片的OSS URI。

OSS地址规则为`oss://bucket/object`，其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的OSS Bucket名称，object为文件路径
parameters.name: image_uri

parameters.help_en: The face ID that already exists in the media set
parameters.help_zh: 媒体集中已存在的人脸ID
parameters.name: face_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of most similar images to return. Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 返回最相似图片的最大个数，默认值为10，取值范围为1~100
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: Filters out images from the results whose similarity is lower than this value
parameters.help_zh: 过滤返回结果中相似度低于该值的图片
parameters.name: min_similarity

parameters.help_en: The format version of the response. If this parameter is not set, the response is returned in the legacy format. Set this parameter to v2
parameters.help_zh: 返回值的格式版本，不设置此参数则返回值的格式为旧版本，推荐设置此参数为v2
parameters.name: response_format
